name: F/6.3 Photography
description: F/6.3 Photography Club is the official photography club of RV College of Engineering, dedicated to fostering creativity and visual storytelling. The club provides a platform for students to explore photography, videography, editing, and creative media through workshops, photowalks, campus event coverage, competitions, and collaborative projects. Members also have opportunities to participate in photography competitions, enhance their technical and creative skills, and connect with a community of passionate creators.

events.name: Blindfold Click Challenge
events.detail: Participants work in teams of 2–4. One member is blindfolded and acts as the photographer, while the rest guide them verbally to frame and capture the shot. The most creative (or funniest!) photos win.

events.name: Campus Photo Story Challenge
events.detail: Explore the campus and capture 5 photos that together tell a story or follow a theme. It's a fun way to combine photography with creativity and visual storytelling.
